pages.text: With cast iron ingots and sheets you can craft the parts of the steel line:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Cast iron pipe$(): 2 sheets + 1 ingot in a row give 4 pipes.$(li)$(item)Cast iron fluid tank$(): a barrel between 2 sheets, stacked vertically.

$(li)$(item)Cast iron mechanical pump$(): a Create cogwheel + a cast iron pipe.$(li)$(item)Cast iron flywheel$(): 8 ingots around a Create shaft.$(li)Cast iron $(item)frames$() and $(item)trusses$() from nuggets, for decoration.$(br2)$(l)The first machines$()

$(li)$(item)Coke oven$(): 4 cast iron ingots around a Create $(item)industrial iron block$() give 2 coke ovens.$(li)$(item)Casting basin$(): 3 fireproof brick items, 1 cast iron pipe and 5 cast iron ingots.$(li)$(item)Blast stove$(): 2 cast iron pipes, 2 cast iron tanks and 2 fireproof brick blocks give 2 stoves.

$(li)$(item)Blast furnace output$(): 4 fireproof brick blocks, 4 cast iron pipes and a block of cast iron.$(li)$(item)Blast furnace hatch$(): 4 fireproof brick blocks, 2 cast iron sheets, 2 cast iron pipes and a cast iron tank.
None of these needs steel: you can build the whole steel line from this page.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
